t: These 1500 LED compact string Christmas lights deliver bright decorative illumination for festive displays. Ideal for decorating 10ft Christmas trees, patios, and gardens, this very warm white set works seamlessly indoors and outdoors. Featuring a 37.47m lit length and a 10m green cable, the mains-powered lights easily cover large areas. An integrated timer automatically runs for 6 hours on and 18 hours off. A selection of 8 distinct lighting modes allows patterns to suit any atmospheric design. An IP44 rating ensures reliable, water-resistant performance throughout the festive season.
